modelIntro.title: What Is PixVerse V6 AI Video Generator?
description: PixVerse V6 is a flexible video model for text-to-video and image-to-video creation. On Toolaze, it supports up to two reference images, native audio output, multi-shot prompts, 1 to 15 second timing, and resolutions from 360p through 1080p.

Use it when you need quick control over format, length, and sound without locking into a single cinematic style. It is useful for creator hooks, product tests, animated reference images, social ads, ambience clips, and ASMR-style material shots.

howToUse.title: How to Use PixVerse V6 on Toolaze

steps.title: Choose text or reference-led creation
steps.desc: Start from a text prompt for a fresh scene, or upload one or two reference images when the subject, product, costume, or visual style needs to stay close to source material.

steps.title: Set the format before writing the scene
steps.desc: Pick the aspect ratio, choose a duration from 1 to 15 seconds, and select 360p, 540p, 720p, or 1080p so the prompt can focus on motion instead of settings.

steps.title: Describe motion, camera, and sound together
steps.desc: Give PixVerse V6 a compact shot order, camera movement, subject action, lighting, and native audio cues such as ambience, contact sounds, footsteps, or tactile ASMR details.

steps.title: Review the result against the references
steps.desc: Check whether the clip preserved the key reference details and whether the sound supports the action. Shorten the prompt or split the scene when too many actions compete.

promptExamples.title: PixVerse V6 Prompt Examples
promptExamples.subtitle: Use these prompts with the UI controls for ratio, duration, resolution, and optional native audio.

items.title: Two-Reference Product Clip
items.prompt: Create a clean product video using the uploaded product photo and brand mood image. Keep the bottle shape, label placement, and color palette stable. Begin with a soft orbiting shot, cut to condensation forming on the glass, then end with the product centered under a warm highlight. Add quiet studio ambience and a subtle glass tap.
items.description: Uses two reference images to hold product identity and visual mood.

items.title: Creator Hook
items.prompt: Create an energetic creator intro in a bright apartment studio. The person lifts a compact camera, smiles toward the lens, then the camera swings to reveal a desk setup with lights turning on. Keep the movement smooth, the face natural, and the sound lively with small camera handling noise and room ambience.
items.description: Good for social intros where movement and sound need to feel immediate.

items.title: ASMR Ingredient Detail
items.prompt: Create a macro ASMR shot of coarse sea salt falling onto a dark chocolate dessert. Show grains bouncing, tiny flakes breaking, and a slow focus pull across the surface. Add crisp granular taps, soft plate contact, low room tone, and no music.
items.description: Pairs tactile close-up motion with native audio direction.

items.title: Wide Storyboard Moment
items.prompt: Create a cinematic storyboard clip of an electric bicycle moving through a quiet underpass at night. Start with a wide establishing angle, shift to a low tracking shot beside the wheel, then finish with the rider passing through a pool of blue light. Add tire hum, distant traffic, and soft echo.
items.description: Uses wide framing, shot progression, and environmental sound for a campaign draft.

troubleshooting.title: Better PixVerse V6 Prompt Direction
troubleshooting.subtitle: PixVerse V6 gives cleaner results when the prompt assigns a role to each reference image and keeps the action compact.

items.title: Assign each reference image a job
items.desc: Weak prompt: Use these two images. Better prompt:
items.prompt: Weak: Use these two images. Better: Use the first uploaded image for the product shape and label. Use the second uploaded image for lighting mood and color palette. Keep both stable while creating a soft orbit, a close condensation detail, and a final centered product shot.

items.title: Keep short clips focused
items.desc: Weak prompt: Make a full commercial. Better prompt:
items.prompt: Weak: Make a full commercial. Better: Create one concise product reveal with a slow push-in, a close detail of the material, and a clean final hold. Keep the product centered, use warm side light, and add a soft mechanical click.

items.title: Tie native audio to visible action
items.desc: Weak prompt: Add cinematic sound. Better prompt:
items.prompt: Weak: Add cinematic sound. Better: Add only sounds that match the image: cloth movement as the sleeve turns, a quiet shoe step on concrete, distant room tone, and no music.

faq.q: What is PixVerse V6 best for?
faq.a: PixVerse V6 is best for fast text-to-video or image-to-video drafts where you need flexible duration, broad aspect ratios, native audio, and the option to guide the scene with up to two reference images.

faq.q: Does PixVerse V6 support two reference images?
faq.a: Yes. Toolaze lets PixVerse V6 use up to two reference images. Use one for the main subject and the other for style, lighting, mood, material, or environment guidance.

faq.q: Can PixVerse V6 generate native audio?
faq.a: Yes. Add direct sound cues such as footsteps, glass taps, cloth movement, ambience, granular texture, or room tone so the audio follows visible motion.

faq.q: Is PixVerse V6 suitable for ASMR videos?
faq.a: Yes for short ASMR-style clips. It is especially useful when the prompt describes close framing, material behavior, contact sounds, and a quiet no-music sound bed.

faq.q: How many credits does PixVerse V6 use?
faq.a: PixVerse V6 starts at 8 Credits on Toolaze. Cost changes with duration, resolution, and native audio settings, so check the estimate in the generator before creating.
